notes.title: Gradient Puzzle Maker [New Feature!]
notes.content:
[p]Hello hello! [/p][p]We're pleased to present a [b]brand new free feature update![/b][/p][p][/p][h2]The Gradient Puzzle Maker[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/f7400dc537eb9a7392dc789460e1e21e0e93b774.png"][/img][/p][p]This new free update provides an awesome set of tools that allows you to create as many gradient puzzles as you like, with any colors you can think of, and is of course fully compatible with multiplayer.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/a50f7c4572acdee37af71fb4a113544752dcb29f.png"][/img][/p][h3]Infinite Detail[/h3][p]Because of how the gradients are created it means that they will have [i]infinite detail[/i]. This means that no matter what size puzzle you create, the color transitions will be [i]smoooth[/i]. [/p][p]These screenshots show off an example of an 8,000 piece puzzle. Even with a super large puzzle like this there are no artifacts or imperfections that normal static images could have due to resolution or image quality etc. [/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/583447c17f429fa12fc840c6dbd6cf3ccb14a0d3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/fe3b0242429bcaf7effc87850d2e64040eba6db2.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h3]Getting Started[/h3][p]To get started just go to Select New Puzzle, then look for the new Gradient Maker button in the list:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/8b7a24d62e413f74cbc082134fcde45334ca6059.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Options Options Options[/h3][p]There's multiple options for creating gradients, Grid and Stripes, each with their own unique settings that allows for lots of experimentation. [/p][list][*][p][b]Grid type Gradients[/b][/p][p]Edit colors for 8 points that blend around this gradient type. Each point can be toggled on or off to offer even more possibilities. [/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/64716c51d58a6c41b4a8b80360d39c1e6c81ca99.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/5aa0e97ad42f829b2ebee0fddb94b33fb6896ab1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/924e7106153775bf00aaeb7939fcddc65d628b13.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/059e88489b82880ffa847c4ea3ece0a8de307112.png"][/img][/carousel][/*][*][p][b]Stripe type Gradients[/b][/p][p]Add as many stripes as you want with up to 16 colors per stripe. Add multiple colors to blend between, or try non-blended single colors for an extra challenge[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/d6e2fb2feb37dd36defe413ade37469e3952f469.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/9a4bc8af18fd304bec6ffc371718b558dc690d27.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/0f0f96aaf73bbe437e272a0616f43ee57305eb16.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/82e31917f44b79164333fe7a90f1b9e8f99699b7.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]You can use Stripe Blend to create unique gradients between Stripes, or set to 0 for hard edges[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/660a4cac60ebe1def02b504e88689246069b87d1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Adjustable Aspect Ratio[/h3][p]Make your puzzles as wide or tall as you'd like![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/444e2c74a52ebb951c558c17d4e420769fefac50.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Presets[/h3][p]Once you've created your perfected gradients, you can save them as a preset. We've also of course included a wide range of default presets so that you can get right to puzzling. These can also be edited to easily adjust colors and settings to your liking.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/93ea83df18784ef1a872e660bfaf792dfe03ca26.png"][/img]

[b]Full Patch Notes:[/b]  [/p][list][*][p]Added New Gradient Puzzle Maker[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where preview image remained locked after starting a new puzzle [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where preview image button showed when selecting to not show preview image[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with chair collision that could causes pieces to disappear[/p][/*][*][p]Updated main chair collision to be much more accurate[/p][/*][*][p]When rotation is off and puzzle is taller than table but will fit sideways, game now changes the fixed rotation to make sure it fits on the table[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crash when attempting to grab connected pieces in Pickup Single Piece mode and then switching back to Normal grab mode[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where puzzle timer would show when no puzzle was loaded[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where timer did not show the first time you loaded a puzzle[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue clicking on another color while color picker is open in edit cursor trails menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where settings menu was cut off on certain resolutions
[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope you all enjoy! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/fba38e7a6bc040f68c634ec0a6647df1b5b46c44.png"][/img]

This is just the beginning, as we plan to add more options to this down the line.  Next though we'll be focused on going through our list of user suggestions and bug fixes.  After that the next big update planned;  Having multiple puzzles loaded in the room at the same time![/p][hr][/hr][p]If you've enjoyed these free updates consider supporting us by purchasing a DLC or donating to our Patreon.  Every dollar gives us more time to work on awesome games and updates to Jigsaw Puzzle Dreams!

[url="https://www.patreon.com/thatsnicegames/membership"]https://www.patreon.com/thatsnicegames/membership[/url]
[/p][p]We've are also starting work on a new game!  It's really early stages so cannot say much, but can say it will be a game focused on exploration across the sea and islands inspired by games like Sea of Thieves and Minecraft.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Stickers and More added to Discount Bundle!

However during development the pack ended up becoming much more.[/p][p]Because of all we ended up adding (over 2,000 stickers, over 200 challenges to complete, tons of indie game stickers, cursor trails) it ended up becoming much more than a supporter pack although we still ended up releasing it as such.  Previously it stood alone as an extra bonus and players were often missing out on it with the existing bundle that only contains extra puzzles.[/p][p]So finally we've decided to include the sticker pack in an all-in-one DLC bundle. The previous bundle with only the puzzle packs will still be available, while the new [i]Complete Pack[/i] bundle that includes everything will be discounted even more for [b]45% off[/b].[/p][p]Keep in mind if you already purchased the puzzle packs you can still use the Complete Pack bundle to get a discount on the [i]Stickers & More[/i] DLC.[/p][p][/p][h2]What's contained in the Stickers and More Pack[/h2][p]Here is a rundown of what to expect from purchasing the DLC.[/p][p]The sticker pack contains over 2,000 unique stickers to unlock. notes.title: Mega Updates : Part 2
notes.content:
Part 2 of the Mega Updates is finished!  Next up we'll work on finishing the gradient puzzle maker, but before that we're going to spend some time tracking down a game crash players have reported. We haven't been able to duplicate it locally so we'll be creating some debug builds and joining games until we can get this game up to 100% stable again.

We hope you enjoy these new features and fixes!

[h3]New Materials Interface for Customize Room[/h3]
We've created a completely new way to edit materials in your room!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/d020daf7319872fbf714c9c2c79091fa9417a7bb.gif[/img]

This new interface was quite the undertaking, requiring ~300 screenshots for all the thumbnails, but the effort was worth it. Having a visual representation makes it so much easier to use, and really makes the experience more fun overall. 

We even included all new default color schemes for most materials to help show off the possibilities and inspire new interior designs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/27de93afba1c36c81afe8a30e403ba4e1e8165f4.png[/img]

[h3]Lockable Preview Image[/h3]
We've expanded the Locked Pieces functionality that was added in the 1.2 update to now also allow you to lock the Preview Image. This should help prevent accidental pickup and ensure the preview stays exactly where you want it.

To use this just press the Lock Pieces button in game (bottom right buttons), or press Ctrl-L. Click the preview to make it turn red (this means it's locked), then just click Done on the Lock Pieces interface. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/b075c177400149b412d173e84f5f3e684daf655f.gif[/img]

[h3]Added Pagination to Save Lists and Custom Images[/h3]
Pagination UI has now also been added to the Saved Puzzle and Custom Images sections. This will vastly improve load times when browsing these lists and overall make the experience much easier, especially for those who already have a lot of saved puzzles and custom images.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/c35c611e0208a54997983a9fc22cfbc5e10726c4.png[/img]

[h3]New Customization Material Options[/h3]
6 new Materials options have been added for customizing your walls!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/ad07d55d0d21e26f2fd8a136a4f152b24d6a4a50.png[/img]
Each material is fully customizable with 4 color slots so that you can create the perfect scheme for your room. 

[b]These materials were added to the Scenic and Idyllic dlc packs as follows:[/b]
[list]
[*] 3 Overlay wall styles added to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832734/Jigsaw_Puzzle_Dreams__Scenic_Pack/][u][b]Scenic Pack[/b][/u][/url]
[*] 3 Herringbone wall styles added to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832732/Jigsaw_Puzzle_Dreams__Idyllic_Pack/][b][u]Idyllic Pack[/u][/b][/url]
[/list]

See you next time!

notes.title: Mega Updates : Part 1
notes.content:
Hey all!  Soon we will be releasing a new addition to allow creating your own gradient puzzles, but before finishing that I decided it was time to work on some fixes I've been putting off for awhile.  There's a good reason I've been avoiding them as some of these issues took months of work to solve (the new bevel GPU calculations alone is something I didn't even know was possible but I kept plugging away until it worked!).  

The Mega Updates will be broken up into two parts with this first part having more major changes, and the second part mainly a list of bug fixes and tweaks.

I'm glad it's finally done and will be great to move forward on a more solid ground with more additions in the future.  Enjoy!

[h3]Room Lighting Updated![/h3]
After weeks spent wrestling with Unreal Engine's volumetric lighting and adding blocking volumes we've fixed most of the issues with an overhauled lighting design. Puzzles pieces now correctly match the area they are in and wall hangings no longer "glow" from outside light.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/9ec3a2dda89cde3ac4a23955d62a8e0dbefeec40.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/d0aba6284f5b9f3f9568bc7cec8608cade666c73.png[/img]

[h3]More Places to Hang Puzzles[/h3]
While knee deep in wall hanging code I decided to fix another pet peeve of mine, room collision areas preventing puzzles from being placed in certain areas. You can now place puzzles on other walls, windows, railings, ceilings and more. Plus there's a new interface that changes to an icon notifying you if it can be placed or not.

[h3]Game Install Size Reduced by 2GB[/h3]
When uploading Unreal Engine games to Steam one of the issues is Steam is unable to read regular compressed files to apply updates.  With the number of very high resolution puzzle images we have this has always been an annoyance.  However we recently found a way to compress the install in a way Steam can still read it and have reduced the install size by over 2GB!

[h3]Vastly Improved Puzzle Bevel [i](Mega Bevel)[/i][/h3] 
While working on the upcoming Gradient Puzzle update I didn't like how the current bevel was looking on solid colors. This has been a long time coming but I finally ditched the old system and came up with a new way to generate the beveled edge for all the custom pieces. 
I present [i]The Mega Bevel[/i]!

High resolution tiled mip mapped textures are scaled to the puzzle size created fully on the GPU in a fraction of the time it took before. You don't want to know the hours spent learning new maths for this, but the end result was well worth it:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/288c16e8c686e7042d45a4a8a432cef27cb0faca.png[/img]

[i](Click images to view full)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/a55ee498a3fee7819dc44ea0fed07377796a1d74.png[/img]

Not only does it look better, it solves a lot of issues compared to the old method, including better memory management, faster loading, and ability to hang more puzzles on the wall before your graphics card starts complaining!

Also no need to cache normal maps as these can now be generated in real time which leads us to...

[h3]Custom Puzzles on Walls Synced in Multiplayer[/h3]
Now that puzzle bevels can be created without needing a long load time I decided it was time to look into another long running issue. Syncing custom and dlc puzzles on the wall in multiplayer.

Custom puzzles displayed on your wall will now be automatically downloaded for all your friends to see. 

[i]Note that puzzles need to be uploaded to the Steam Workshop for this to happen.

This feature can be disabled in the main settings area.[/i]

[h3]Added pagination to wall hangings[/h3]  
Not only is this much easier to navigate your completed puzzles for decorating, those with lots of completed puzzles will load into the customize room interface [i]much much[/i] faster.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/7b01468ea35915dc4e037459fa4aa3c81813d92a.png[/img]

I'll be adding pagination to custom and saved puzzle areas as well in the next patch.

[h3]New Video Settings[/h3]
Many new performance options have been added for the textures of the new bevel generation, as well as for the puzzles images themselves (both for active puzzles, and puzzles hung on the wall). We also added a new option to remove the puzzle bevel for those that would prefer that.

These options can be found in Settings > Video Settings

The graphic settings have been moved to it's own file to avoid unwanted steam syncing and to make it easier to reset back to defaults. This will make for a better experience especially for those switching between different computers.

A lot of code was changed to allow stickers in game and in multiplayer, so we decided to have a preload of the update to address any bugs affecting the main game before the sticker pack comes out.

Right now everything is feature complete and we are working on polishing, bug fixing, and testing before the release on Jan 25.

Now that we have the interface in here are some more details on how things work.

[h3]Sticker Sheets[/h3]
Stickers come arranged on sticker sheets in different categories.  You start with a few unlocked and can unlock more with sticker challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/d1716743ca24798322ece23ead48351ce3a6cada.gif[/img]

[h3]Sticker Challenges[/h3]
Solving challenges will either unlock new stickers or a whole new sticker sheet.  After you unlock stickers more challenges show up using those stickers.

To solve a challenge use the clues to figure out how to solve the puzzle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/2272e9889451ee555a9ca74aafd7a50f5897ee4a.gif[/img]

[h3]Cursor Trails[/h3]
Cursor trails activate temporarily by pressing a button and leave a cursor trail behind for a short while.  These can be used to celebrate or bring attention to your cursor in multiplayer!

There will be a number of different styles to choose from, like snow, smoke, butterflies, and puzzle pieces with their own unique animations.

Each style can then be further customized by changing the colors and selecting effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/6245c48f2f7e3a2d53c9262762096144f3bb4711.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/829601bd87cdf265f9c14ccb63d8e30e21750d63.gif[/img]

[h3]Sticker Permissions[/h3]
With all these stickers we figured people might want to be able to manage them in multiplayer, especially if streaming to a large group of players.

With sticker permissions you can limit how many stickers players can place, or restrict placing stickers to certain areas to keep the puzzling area clean. 
 
[i]*This interface is available to everyone even if you don't have the DLC.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/863a6bbf3df42fc5c88edc733d7f2f4205a84a0f.png[/img]

notes.title: Stickers & More! Supporter Pack is almost here!
notes.content:
[h1]Store Page is Live![/h1]

We're almost there! The Stickers & More Supporter pack will be releasing 01/25. 
Wishlist today to get notified on release day!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2763190/Jigsaw_Puzzle_Dreams_Stickers_and_More__Supporter_Pack/

What will this pack include? Let's get into it what we've been working on! 

[h1]Custom Cursor Trails[/h1]
I've been having a lot of fun working on special effects for a bunch of different cursor trail effects.  All have customizable colors and effects and come in many styles.
Butterflies, bats, fire, snow, puzzles pieces, and more!  Every effect comes with special animations to match it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/ab71ae085d111b2e3355de8569ca2138b1631303.gif[/img]

The effect will activate with a button press and last a short while.  We quickly realized having it on all the time becomes distracting so now it works like a boost button which is much better.  You can activate it to bring attention to an area of the puzzle or celebrate a piece being put in.  At the end of a puzzle everyone can boost their cursor trails to celebrate.  It's really great and I can't wait to try it in a real game :).

[h1]Indie Game Stickers![/h1]
When we were coming up with sticker ideas we kept returning to thoughts of how people would put stickers of their favorite bands on things and that got us thinking.  How do we recreate that feel in a video game?
We've collaborated with over 30 indie game studios to include a huge collection of stickers featuring  their fantastic game art, iconic characters, and logos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/b098a4851fc1f62b5d681e8d6273ca49d8336596.png[/img]

[h1]More and more stickers, over 2,000 stickers![/h1]
All stickers are finalized and in game and we are at the final stages.  We started with a dozen but kept thinking of more we wanted and once we had those we didn't want to leave out the possibility of not having what you want so added more, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/7da948259c7f85057bfc3caaa6af3e61ec233600.png[/img]

[h1]Sticker Challenges[/h1]
Unlock hundreds of stickers through sticker challenges.  Use the hints to figure out the sticker combination to beat the challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/c539b5f71005a60e871f9f7f4b35d130b5701802.png[/img]

[h1]DLC page is up, wishlist now![/h1]
We've started working on the store page and will be adding more details in the coming days.
Add the DLC to your wishlist to get notified on release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2763190/Jigsaw_Puzzle_Dreams_Stickers_and_More__Supporter_Pack/


[b]Thanks to everyone who has supported our game, and to all the awesome indie studios who gave us the opportunity to feature their fantastic creations as stickers![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/fba38e7a6bc040f68c634ec0a6647df1b5b46c44.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/fba38e7a6bc040f68c634ec0a6647df1b5b46c44.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/fba38e7a6bc040f68c634ec0a6647df1b5b46c44.png[/img]


We'll be uploading a pre-load soon so we can work out any non sticker bugs ahead of time. Then after release we'll go over a list of updates and additions planned for the main game.  If everything goes well we will have more time to focus on many more additions to the game into the future!

notes.title: Progress Report: Stickers, Stickers, Stickers!
notes.content:
Hi all, just an update on our progress with the upcoming Supporter DLC.

[h3]First up, stickers.[/h3]  

I've been tweaking the materials to make the stickers as realistic as possible while also adding in options for special types like foil stickers
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/1f821adcf76ce859df171ab7d34df1557d12d4aa.gif[/img]

I've also added in tools to the game to allow Nic to quickly import stickers and modify all the shading options so his work on designing can go a lot faster.

Speaking of which we haven't ever mentioned our development team before.  It consists of me (Shawn) who works on all of the programming for the game and my brother Nic who does all graphic design for game interface, update posts, and is currently working on secret stickers not yet shown!

In addition to foil stickers I've been experimenting with adding a worn look although I'm not sure what to do with it yet.

We were originally thinking of having stickers wear out in high traffic areas with a lot of puzzle pieces but that really limits any stickers having the effect.  Another idea is just have them wear out over time although I wouldn't want all original placed stickers to wear out at exactly the same time.  Maybe in the end we will just put in an option for users to modify them if they wish.

I'm not really sure but it does look pretty cool :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/679eeeb4c89ef1117b112b4fe1a0442957e90fb5.png[/img]


[h3]Next up, more stickers.[/h3]  
What started as a few fun bonuses for a supporter DLC has now taken on a life of it's own and as such there is going to be more stickers than we originally planned.  Much more.  Much, much, much more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/84d48f3009c59024f8fe8db8a6de5f82495e58ef.png[/img]

In the words of John Hammond: "spared no expense".  

Hopefully this does not all end with us eating our last ice cream before it melts because our power got shut off :).

[h3]Also sticker puzzles![/h3]  

In addition to the stickers you get we will also be including a number of challenges to unlock even more.  

We originally thought of the idea of including some secret easter eggs like if you put sunglasses on Dracula you unlock a bonus sticker and then just couldn't stop thinking of ideas until we decided to just include a full list of puzzles to do with the stickers.

The idea is there will be a list of hints and by placing stickers in certain ways you unlock more stickers which in turn will unlock more challenges.

As an example a hint could be "unlock the chest" and by placing a sticker of a key on top of a treasure chest sticker you unlock more stickers.  Then those stickers can be used for future puzzles too.

On the topic of combining stickers I haven't had much time to just play around too much with all the work to be done but am already seeing this as a game changer for fun hijinks in multiplayer!

Here is a cool cat with sunglasses hanging out with a guitar playing Dracula wearing a top hat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/2c11f9b05e6af1e22612f4646ad971e7af5e7d37.png[/img]

Or adding stickers to your finished puzzles on the wall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/5dda2c8ddb8f54d80088aa3d146dc33e9f81ff37.png[/img]

[h3]Halloween has been extended for another month![/h3]  
We had hoped to be able to release this update this month and in anticipation have added loads of Halloween themed stickers.  Since that's looking less and less likely we will be officially extending the holiday one month for anyone playing Jigsaw Puzzle Dreams :).  

And if you are not into that, don't worry there will be plenty of sticker themes for other seasons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/1d4ffffbe56fe3a76ec9327056cddd88585791b9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/d37d14675799f261f2018aae40fb39048762bdc0.png[/img]

I'll post more updates as we have more completed, including details on custom cursor trails and possibly a bonus puzzle.

And to fill in anyone not here for the last post this all will be included in an upcoming "Supporter" DLC that will sell for $9.99.  

People with the DLC will be able to decorate their own room with stickers and also place stickers in the rooms of friends in multiplayer, even if they do not own any DLC.  They will stay even after you leave the game.

notes.title: Spooky Bonus + Update on Future Plans
notes.content:
[h1]New Free Carpet and Rug Design[/h1]

It's that time of the year for spooky movies (and spooky puzzles!).  To get in the spirit we have added a free bonus some of you might recognize from a certain hotel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/b2aa9940ba9fc6cd6008be815ed08878d444a8ac.png[/img]

This new design is free for everyone and can be applied to the floors or rug!

To select it enter customize room, choose floors or rug, and select it from the drop-down menu at the top.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/cf251d190ffdb17409ad7481b5607ebdab8d37bc.gif[/img]

Like all of our materials you can change the color of everything to use in your room design in many different ways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/56a74a302ee1b02222b1d7057ef50ee2d03eb576.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/b520cc546976533a4c295dd215a4100b3b52b2f7.gif[/img]

[h1]Future Plans:  Supporter DLC[/h1]

We have a lot of updates planned for the future.  Improved lighting, variable sized rooms, multiple puzzles simultaneously, different piece cuts and more!

However to get to all of that we need more time.  The game has been doing well, so well that we are close but not close enough to be able to spend more time working on the game and less time on our day jobs.

To push us over the hump we will be releasing a supporter DLC with lots of fun extras!  
It will be available in the future for $9.99 for anyone that wants to help support further updates.

We have been having a lot of fun coming up with fun extras to include in the pack and will be posting updates as we work on it.

[h3]First up, stickers![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/07cbdcb432c53ceefc0c3d62c2a67d53b1ba1a05.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/5f334686a2a382a0fbaf12f5ed2d28cde1b322be.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/cda1304ed5d981c0277166c57509d12fe71aec08.gif[/img]


Fully multiplayer compatible, players can stick them in rooms they visit where they will be saved with the room and remain even when you leave the game!  (Host may choose to limit stickers at their discretion)

These are designed for minimal performance impact so you can sticker bomb the room!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/76f98e4035253be4eb78b3df4539f32ac707247b.png[/img]

Stickers shown are early tests and not necessarily what will be in the final release.  We are creating many as we speak and have some extra surprises to show as well.



Lastly the previous update changed a lot with the underlying code and there have been some people with infrequent crashes.   

I haven't been able to find the cause or duplicate on my end yet so I have uploaded a debug version that will give more information in the crash logs.  If you are experiencing game crashes feel free to test with this version and post your crash log on the steam forum or our [url=https://discord.gg/fJwHDT2Cxg][u]discord[/u][/url].

To access this version right click the game and select properties then select it from the Betas tab:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/fff6ed2be3d77acf64256cbed6383129d642cfd2.png[/img]

There is one caveat.  Debug versions of Unreal do not save to the usual place but instead in the game directory.  To change this and use your existing save games you must put "-INSTALLED" in the launch options in steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/36169dc76042128e51bcc76f34b76af8f96eab7a.png[/img]

We have more to reveal and some surprises with the pack and stickers.  I'll be posting updates as we work on it.

[b]Happy Puzzling![/b]

notes.title: Massive Update - 1.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/2f52eafa68a01230ce231ed5f61a1bd8280dad2a.gif[/img]

[b]The 1.3 update is here![/b] It's the biggest update we've put out so far. There's new puzzle interactions, new physics, huge performance optimizations, community requested features (ːLIS_pixel_heartː), and a whole lot more! 

There's a lot of super cool stuff to check out, so let's get into it!

[h1]New Interaction Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][h3]Piece Grouping[/h3]

Press [b]G[/b] after picking up a selection of pieces to group them together

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/03db322e630610faa919f25beadb538aa03b3ca2.gif[/img]

Once grouped, use [b]Shift-Mousewheel up/down[/b] to expand/contract the grouping

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/1711a67e40d928bcf105617ca825e43b4ef88c7e.gif[/img]

Widen or narrow a group with [b]Ctrl-Mousewheel[/b] and [b]Alt-Mousewheel[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/5b7719c3d6e9c41f4736029ae2c0ff768f4b6238.gif[/img]

[i](Note: You must first pickup pieces and press G before being able to use the resizing tools)[/i]

[*][h3]Add Single Pieces to Hand[/h3]

Switch to [i]Pickup Single Piece[/i] mode by pressing [b]Shift-RightMouseButton[/b].
Now each piece you click will be added to a stack in your hand!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/552fbadb87bfe841bac6e869ad21f0586c180031.gif[/img]

[*][h3]Place Single Pieces from Hand[/h3]

Switch to [i]Drop Single Piece[/i] mode by again pressing [b]Shift-RightMouseButton[/b].
Now you can individually drop pieces from your stack:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/fdd39a045f07a4db8f625102fec6ba34626e534b.gif[/img]

[*][h3]Swapping Grab Modes[/h3]

Pressing [b]Shift-RightMouseButton[/b] with a selection of pieces held will toggle between [i]Normal[/i], [i]Pickup Single Piece[/i], and [i]Drop Single Piece[/i]: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/8ee23195e09f7bb9a7e1ae0f911b5c15525ecc4e.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Overhauled Physics + Performance Boost[/h1]

Two things needed to happen for our new grouping features to work smoothly. Physics needed improvement, and optimizations needed to be made. So, we completely reworked the physics, and majorly optimized areas all throughout the game. 

The result is the game now runs better than ever, the physics behave fluidly, 1000s of pieces can be dropped at once ([i]it used to be 50 at a time![/i]) and,

well, 

this is all I want to do now:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/0313dc8d2a290656e2d422181c49f27df3b078d8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/6c911fe34e5c83d7e19c1535a4f7aeabbeca28fc.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/54453941e6c4b6fcf668056a93541efbd0f95abc.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/af8490ed73105b5747f600bbabeeec0aadfd2b5e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/f5015601b183c2d30d25a5400e52f0f97531f76c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/c9d9cee5871b0a4915d2e044481f2c1726710b07.gif[/img]

([i]That last one is ~2.5-3k pieces[/i])

[h1]Stats & Puzzle Timer[/h1]
[list]
[*][h3]Puzzle Stats[/h3]

We've made it more convenient to see puzzle stats while playing by adding a new panel into the main ESC menu. This will show you puzzle size, completion %, and optionally a puzzle timer. 

[i](Note: the second number for puzzle size is the 'actual' piece count, whereas the first number is what you selected. Piece counts can vary, just as they do IRL puzzles, because of the need to match the aspect ratio of the puzzle image.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/779b8927431eb80a7bbe8282d0f8b8bfce0df501.png[/img]

[*][h3]Puzzle Timer[/h3]

A much requested feature, puzzle time tracking has been added!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/7634ff5f17d95e217af7f1af981c7d5c5cb7afaa.gif[/img]

To enable toggle on [i]Show Puzzle Time[/i] in the Settings menu. This will display the timer in the Puzzle Stats panel, the panels for Load Puzzle, and will give a final time on the Puzzle Complete screen.

Additionally you can toggle on [i]Show Timer In Game[/i] to display in the upper corner while you puzzle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/5bc27888294ffce24e3b078089fabcfcf43e15c5.gif[/img]

[i](Note: If you're playing solo the timer will pause if you open the main ESC menu.)[/i]
[/list]


[h1]Random [i]Mystery [/i]Puzzles[/h1]

Can't decide which puzzle to pick? Looking for a bit of mystery? This new feature is for you! 
[list]
[*]A new panel for Random Puzzle is now displayed at the top when choosing a puzzle:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/ba0bdf248ff387af7d7df3461d6b2bd9f6b40509.png[/img]

[*]Increase the puzzle pool by toggling on collection packs. Options are also available to choose if puzzles you've already completed will be included:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/dc095f647e93182acb9b40bc8aa21ee716f17e9e.gif[/img]

[*]A new option allows you to go full mystery mode and hide the preview image:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/7b351fe931af633464eed3d132668a924d9ebe04.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h1]More Graphics Options[/h1]

New graphics settings have been added to adjust the quality for Reflections, Ambient Occlusion, and Anti-aliasing. In addition to all of the optimizations included in this update, tweaking these settings can provide improved performance for an even wider range of hardware configurations. 

We've also included the ability to tweak settings while viewing the room, allowing you to see the visual changes in real-time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/b39e1fb610d1ae700ae6e8120b4e2dbd05c9bc92.gif[/img]

[h1]And More![/h1]

[list]
[*]Puzzle Previews are now resizable. 
Use [b]Shift-Mousewheel up/down[/b] to resize preview while held:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/84fa355990dc7b7588c0a615360f3f232450350a.gif[/img]

[*]Setting up custom key binds has been improved. You now get an overlay with options to Cancel, Clear, Set Default, and the ability to use key modifiers with your mouse has been added (for example: Ctrl-Shift-Mousebutton).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/0c9abcf17965011ddc319af91a3362f71c224287.png[/img]

[*]Improved loading bars & added Cancel Button:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/971f61ec51dcb856e191a461d8c9bec06400e158.gif[/img]

[*]Improved material and rendering for puzzle backing:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/c3570c0245868476318942a74f72842c8cbe3884.png[/img]

[*]And...well...even more! See full patch notes below:

[/list]

[h3]Full Patch Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added new Grouping features when selecting pieces
[*]Added new feature to add one piece at a time to your hand into a stack, and to place one at a time from the stack
[*]Added stats display to main menu (% complete, puzzle size, optional timer). These are also displayed to clients joined in multiplayer.
[*]Added option to show timer for puzzles (hours, minutes, seconds). Can be displayed in-game, on main menu stats panel, and will show in the save file info panel
[*]Overhauled puzzle physics and geometry. Results in performance boost as well as ability to move/drop large amounts of pieces at once. 
[*]Major improvements in performance for multi-select, significant improvements using multi-select with larger puzzles
[*]Significant general performance improvements
[*]Added ability to select a random "mystery" puzzle!  
[list]
[*]Can choose puzzle packs (including custom images) to include in the random selection pool
[*]Options to not include already finished puzzles or only include puzzles finished below a certain size
[/list][*]Added ability to increase/decrease size of preview image (Shift-mousewheel when held)
[*]Default preview image size improved for extra wide puzzles
[*]Added more graphics options (Ambient Occlusion, Reflections, Post-Process, Anti-Aliasing)
[*]Added ability to preview room/game while making adjustments to graphics options
[*]Improved custom key binds & Controls
[list]

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Hello! The new update is here! It features the much requested Lock Pieces function, as well as improvements and fixes for multiplayer.

We had been working on some major code rewrites and changes to the engine leading up to this update, which were necessary to do first, but were a big reason for the gap in time since the last update. With that work out of the way we'll be in a good position to update more frequently now, so expect more to come in the near future!

Until then, see below for patch notes as well as a little overview of how Lock Pieces works:

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]New feature added that allows player to lock pieces in place
[*]Fixed multiplayer issue causing client to sometimes get desynced with players which could cause players to be mismatched on piece connections/placements
[*]Fixed multiplayer [i]Join Code[/i] issue that caused some players to not be able to connect (long distance connections were especially prone to this issue)
[*]Fixed multiplayer issue that sometimes caused host's main table color to not sync with joining players	
[*]Fixed "[i]Return pieces to table[/i]" issues (Updated "return boundaries" to prevent stuck pieces)
[*]Updated the visual feedback for the [i]Select Multiple Pieces[/i] function 
[*]Major code rewrite on how the jigsaw puzzle and multiplayer works
[list]
[*]This improves/changes a lot of things behind the scenes, but a big takeaway is that it'll make future updates much easier to implement.[/list][/list]

[h2]New Feature: Lock Pieces[/h2]	

This new feature allows players to lock a piece or section of pieces in place. After locking a piece or section any pieces connected to them will also become locked. This is especially useful for locking the edges/border in place, and will prevent players from accidentally "[i]picking up the whole puzzle[/i]". 

[list]
[*]With an active puzzle loaded you'll find a new Lock Pieces button in the bottom UI. (In multiplayer games only the room host will have this)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/2442a7a7f8f5bdbbf94a43640f3fd122ccab6874.gif[/img]

[*]This will bring you into the Lock Pieces mode. You can now click any piece or chunks of pieces (like the edge) to toggle the locked status on/off. Locked pieces will be marked with a red border.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41066295/ced3a3f7febecb45de09226ae392eda8be65c541.gif[/img]

[*]Any piece connected to a locked piece will also become locked.

[*]Clicking locked pieces will flash red to let players know they can't be moved.

[*]In Multiplayer games only the host can lock pieces, but the locked status applies to all other players.
[/list]

Feedback? Questions? Looking for players? [url=https://discord.gg/fJwHDT2Cxg][u]Join our Discord[/u][/url] or pop over to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1653970/discussions/][u]Steam Community[/u][/url]!
